item.title: Pieter Mulier Has Parted Ways With Alaïa
item.description: After a five-year tenure that brought Alaïa both critical and commercial success, Pieter Mulier has stepped down as creative director.

item.title: 14 Of Leonardo DiCaprio’s Best Roles To Date
item.description: As Leonardo DiCaprio celebrates his eighth Oscar nomination for ‘One Battle After Another’, we look back on his most impactful performances so far.

item.title: Bobbi Brown On How To Give Your Lipstick Longevity
item.description: As part of Vogue’s Beauty Crash Course series, the make-up guru, Bobbi Brown, walks us through how to maximise the lasting power of your lip look.

item.title: 19 Celebrities Who Have (Surprisingly) Never Won An Oscar
item.description: Believe it or not, Ethan Hawke, Annette Bening, Glenn Close, Samuel L Jackson, and many other Hollywood A-listers have never won an Academy Award. Here, Vogue breaks down 19 celebs who have surprisingly never won an Oscar.

item.title: Let It Be! The Beatles Biopic Is Coming, Dramatic Hair Transformations And All
item.description: A first look at the Beatles biopic’s Barry Keoghan, Paul Mescal, Harris Dickinson, and Joseph Quinn playing the British quartet – and their Beatlesmaxxing glam.

item.title: Why Skims Is The Ultimate Bra Destination
item.description: The best Skims bras, tried and tested by the Vogue team, to add to your collection.

item.title: 6 Buzzy Moments You Might Have Missed From Copenhagen Fashion Week AW26
item.description: Copenhagen Fashion Week’s AW26 edition celebrated the event’s 20th anniversary. From catwalk cameos from Ella Emhoff and Linnea Berthelsen to Anne Sofie Madsen’s Ugg collaboration, see all the moments you might have missed from Copenhagen Fashion Week AW26.

item.title: Ceramide Serums Are The Skin-Barrier Heroes Your Routine Is Missing
item.description: Ceramides work for all skin types, and make harsh actives like retinol more tolerable. They support the skin barrier and boost hydration. Here are Vogue‘s pick of the best.

item.title: A Fashion History Of The Most Fantastical High Heels To Hit The Runway
item.description: From the toadstool-ettos at Matthieu Blazy’s Chanel couture debut to Jonathan Anderson’s Loewe egg heels and towering Mugler platforms, fashion has a long, proud history of fantasy-fuelled footwear.

item.title: ‘Schitt’s Creek’ And ‘Home Alone’ Star Catherine O’Hara Has Died At 71
item.description: Catherine O’Hara – the Canadian-American actress, comedian, and screenwriter who left an indelible mark on comedy – is dead at 71. A representative for her manager’s office confirmed O’Hara’s death from a brief illness to the press on Friday.
